description: Trait modifier and stat limit definitions for 'The Inertia' RPG characters.

trait_unyielding_survival.name: Will to Live at All Costs
trait_unyielding_survival.effect: Medical training and preservation instincts override passivity.
trait_unyielding_survival.vulnerability: Will to live cannot magically resist kinetic impact or targeted attack; 25% failure chance under physical assault to reflect physiological limits.
